description: B6 side measurement: the tracked unit dies with a build order armed. A CORCK at 10 percent health and a CORAK on open ground (Two Continents SW), an ARM LLT out of their reach to the east. Select the CORCK, press a build button (main+0x2CC3 = 0x0E), then order it (tacli order, not the mouse) into the LLT's range; read 0x2CC3, 0x2CC4 and the tracked unit 0x37E9C before and after it dies, and watch the build ghost.
